scope: Restricted finite-table proof and deterministic counterexamples; no general hidden-state or final-study acceptance

findings.finding: Action precedes observation loss, which precedes reward. Prefix includes the current retention factor. Absorbing dropout contributes zero without accessing later histories.

Explicit consistency, sequential exchangeability, noninformative observation and support connect the observed prefix to the full-cohort policy value. Estimated observed probabilities alone do not establish these premises.

Each dated cell receives at most one contribution per independent customer. Conditional binomial concentration then averaging over membership controls its random count. A union bound permits dependence between cells; empty cells retain radius one.
Projection uses externally stipulated true support floors; it cannot establish them. Table cells are fixed before training; arbitrary discretization and adaptive partitions are excluded.

Density-change identity, nonnegative product perturbation, bounded score concentration and union of nuisance/evaluation events yield coverage of the realized trained policy. Conditional evaluation control does not confer uniform conditional coverage over bad training samples.
Fixed finite cell count and positive reach probability imply shrinking nuisance errors; constants deteriorate with horizon and support. No arbitrary learner or continuous-history rate.

Policy selection may share training with the fitted probabilities. Evaluation is independent. Simultaneous finite-class intervals allow a post-evaluation selection only among already covered candidates; no unrestricted optimum claim.

Three intervention path sums match an independent backward recursion and observed prefix sums exactly. Perturbed-denominator expectation matches density-change formula and lies inside the bound. Current-only shortcut fails. Fifteen exact binomial sums pass their nominal inequality.

Both hidden-confounding worlds have the same observed joint law with private-state overlap .2/.8, but action effects .6 versus zero. Missing-outcome worlds have means .25/.75 under identical observed records.
Evaluation radius 8.24269 exceeds the entire eight-unit target range at n=1000 even before nuisance error. No useful-width acceptance or new coverage experiment.

R03 supplied logger/audit scope and wrong-logger/leakage failures remain. P4 Gaussian/quadratic unbounded rewards and continuous histories do not satisfy this theorem. Capping changes target and requires prior declaration.

repairs_during_review: Explicitly coded retention as C=1 to avoid confusion with the inherited censoring convention.
Kept the evaluator-only complete paths separate from score access after dropout.
Separated confidence in a realized trained policy, finite-class best value, and unrestricted optimal value.
Identified the continuous P4 reward incompatibility before approving a final experiment.
